The carousel indexes powder module 6 (green) to the station, 8 chain links per module, and the Actuonix P16 lifts the electronics carriage and docks it under the module's plate, magnet on.

The carousel indexes powder module 6 (green) to the station, 8 chain links per module, and the Actuonix P16 lifts the electronics carriage and docks it under the module's plate, magnet on. The other modules are drawn see-through: the docked one rides inside the loop.

Module 6 tilts 30°, cap end up into the loop, and the auger turns through the steel pinion: the powder drops through the D-cut funnel into the upright vial while the load cell counts it. Then hold, tilt back, reverse one turn at rest, undock (powder-doser's leakage study).
